name: quasi
description: Academic research toolkit — search, download, extract, analyze, synthesize

cookiecloud_server.title: CookieCloud endpoint
cookiecloud_server.description: Endpoint of your CookieCloud server used to pull browser cookies for EZProxy downloads, e.g. https://cookiecloud.example.com. Leave empty to disable EZProxy entirely. Stored in the system keychain.

cookiecloud_uuid.title: CookieCloud user key (UUID)
cookiecloud_uuid.description: The 'user KEY' set in the CookieCloud Chrome extension. Stored in the system keychain.

cookiecloud_password.title: CookieCloud E2E password
cookiecloud_password.description: End-to-end encryption password set in the CookieCloud Chrome extension. Stored in the system keychain.

cookiecloud_ezproxy_domain.title: EZProxy cookie domain
cookiecloud_ezproxy_domain.description: Cookie domain used by your institution's EZProxy after login, e.g. .idm.oclc.org or ezproxy.example.edu. This is not the login URL; only cookies on this exact domain are kept. Stored in the system keychain.

cookiecloud_ezproxy_base_url.title: EZProxy base URL
cookiecloud_ezproxy_base_url.description: Base URL of your institution's EZProxy, e.g. https://ezproxy.example.edu. quasi appends /login?url= internally. Stored in the system keychain.

anna_donator_key.title: Anna's Archive donator key
anna_donator_key.description: Donator key from https://annas-archive.org/donations — unlocks the Fast Download API used for batch book acquisition. Stored in the system keychain.

translate_backend.title: PDF translation backend
translate_backend.description: Set `immersive` for the Immersive Translate Zotero API or `pdf2zh` for local pdf2zh-next driving your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Stored in the system keychain.

immersive_auth_key.title: Immersive Translate Zotero auth key
immersive_auth_key.description: Auth key for the Immersive Translate Zotero PDF translation API. Used only when the PDF translation backend is `immersive`. Stored in the system keychain.

translate_base_url.title: pdf2zh: API base URL
translate_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL used only by the `pdf2zh` backend. A root URL such as https://api.deepseek.com automatically becomes /v1; an explicit provider path is preserved. Do not include /chat/completions. Stored in the system keychain.

translate_api_key.title: pdf2zh: API key
translate_api_key.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint used by the pdf2zh backend. Stored in the system keychain.

translate_model.title: pdf2zh: model name
translate_model.description: Model id sent to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint by the pdf2zh backend, e.g. deepseek-chat. Stored in the system keychain.

kagi_session_token.title: Kagi session token
kagi_session_token.description: Kagi Session Link URL or raw session token for Douban Chinese-edition discovery. Stored in the system keychain and passed to kagi-cli as KAGI_SESSION_TOKEN.

soniox_api_key.title: Soniox API key
soniox_api_key.description: API key for the Soniox stt-async-v4 speech-to-text engine, used by the collect-material Talk path as the highest-quality transcription engine in the ensemble. Get one at https://soniox.com. Stored in the system keychain.
